description: Switchyard: record session events with `sy hook` (async, never blocks, always exits 0; SessionEnd is synchronous with a 2 s timeout so a closing session still records `ended`). Events from docs/spec/states.md section 2. Seven further synchronous entries (`sy hook --title <Event>`, timeout 1) print the tab title as hook JSON and stay silent unless `terminal.titles` is on (docs/spec/terminal.md T6). One more synchronous SessionStart entry (`sy hook --peers-context SessionStart`, timeout 1) tells a new session that it can reach sessions of other accounts and machines, and stays silent unless peers are enabled and the local matrix lets this account reach another (docs/spec/peers.md 2.5).

hooks.command: command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook SessionStart || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title SessionStart || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --peers-context SessionStart || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook UserPromptSubmit || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title UserPromptSubmit || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook PermissionRequest || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title PermissionRequest || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook Notification || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title Notification || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook PreToolUse || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook Stop || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title Stop || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook StopFailure || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title StopFailure || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook SubagentStop || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook SessionEnd || true
command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook --title SessionEnd || true

command -v sy >/dev/null 2>&1 && sy hook PermissionDenied || true
